name: Hong Kong
tagline: The world's cheapest Michelin-starred pork bun, and the first Chinese restaurant to reach three stars.

Lung King Heen.description: The world's first Chinese restaurant to earn three Michelin stars, a specialist in luxury dim sum. Reviewed by critic Amanda Sheppard for the South China Morning Post.

Tim Ho Wan.description: The world's cheapest Michelin-starred restaurant. Its baked barbecue pork bun is legendary, and Anthony Bourdain ate here on 'Parts Unknown'.

Luk Yu Tea House.description: A classic tea house since the 1930s, with original Art Deco decor.

Yat Lok.description: Michelin-starred roast goose in a simple cha chaan teng-style spot in Central, with more than 20 secret preparation steps.

Australia Dairy Company.description: An iconic Kowloon cha chaan teng, famous for its scrambled eggs and no-nonsense fast service.
